summary: Whether you show it or not, a fast, restless mind and a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you draw people in and know what you want. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: Whether you show it or not, a fast, restless mind and a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you draw people in and know what you want. It rewards you when you reach for it. Diplomacy, the arts, and any work where pleasant, persuasive expression matters.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you draw people in and know what you want.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it.
integration: Let thinking and speech and love and values cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Diplomacy, the arts, and any work where pleasant, persuasive expression matters.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you draw people in work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
